races.title: Sunday At The Races With Greendale EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: OUR WEE HORSE made an encouraging start to his career when runner-up in a Fontwell juvenile hurdle last month and, having had excuses next time, he can build on his debut effort at the second attempt. The pair of newcomers in the line-up could be the main dangers, Naturaouse the pick for second ahead of Golden Dagger . OUR WEE HORSE (IRE) NATURAOUSE (FR) GOLDEN DAGGER
races.bettingForecast: Our Wee Horse (5/4), Naturaouse (13/8), Golden Dagger (3/1), Nichoir (33/1), Royal Castle (66/1)

races.title: Elf Exeter Leukaemia Fund Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Runner-up on her completed start in points, Irish raider CORREEN wouldn't have to be anything out of the ordinary to play a lead role on hurdles debut and earns preference over Poet's Muse . Little Twig may have more to offer now her stamina is tested further following a break. CORREEN (IRE) POET'S MUSE (IRE) LITTLE TWIG (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Poet's Muse (6/5), Seventeenothree (15/8), Correen (9/2), Little Twig (7/1), Stavanger Rose (12/1), Winding Lake (20/1)

races.title: Chris Down A Lifetime In Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: TORRENT made an impressive start over fences when scoring at Uttoxeter last week, going with plenty of enthusiasm in front, so he is taken to follow up with more still to offer. The biggest threat could come from Silver Hill , who wasn't seen to best effect on chasing debut, while Champagne Chic is interesting with his recent run behind him. TORRENT SILVER HILL (IRE) CHAMPAGNE CHIC (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Silver Hill (9/4), Champagne Chic (5/2), Torrent (3/1), Red Dirt Road (6/1), Rickety Bridge (6/1), Solar System (17/2)

races.title: Happy 70th David Clements Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MWABANI put his experience to good use when making a winning return in good style at Chepstow 6 weeks ago and with the prospect of more to come now handicapping, Jane Williams' charge makes plenty of appeal from an opening mark of 115. Treasure Planet would have finished closer but for a late error at Newbury latest and rates next best ahead of Wetherby scorer Washington . MWABANI (FR) TREASURE PLANET (IRE) WASHINGTON
races.bettingForecast: Treasure Planet (2/1), Mwabani (5/2), Handlethekettle (11/4), Washington (4/1), Son Of Hypnos (28/1)

races.title: Exminster Golf Club Supporting Elf Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Things couldn't be going much better for Jamie Snowden and his KEL DU LARGE gets the verdict to open his account over the larger obstacles with his reappearance under his belt. He Knows Better could be the one to give the selection most to think about on reappearance following a breathing operation, with recent winner Sage Green taken to edge out It's A Breeze for minor honours. KEL DU LARGE (FR) HE KNOWS BETTER (IRE) SAGE GREEN (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Sage Green (9/4), Kel Du Large (5/2), Koukeo (11/4), He Knows Better (11/2), Another Folly (11/2), Start Again (10/1), Fight My Fire (10/1), Bonza Boy (11/1), Kingcormac (12/1), It's A Breeze (14/1)

races.title: Exe containers.com 'Four Years Old' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: MECENE has shown plenty of promise to date and can make a winning start in handicaps. One Island remains on a handy mark on his Flat form and isn't one to ignore, with the class-dropping Bandjo another to consider. MECENE (FR) ONE ISLAND (FR) BANDJO (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Mecene (6/4), Bandjo (2/1), The Bellhop (9/4), Arbitration (9/2), Modern Style (5/1), One Island (9/1), Out Of Aces (28/1)

races.title: Exminster Golf Centre Richard Candy Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: The vote goes to ROMANY BROWN , who shaped as though ready to strike at Wetherby last time. The balance could tip toward Blue In The West if conditions become testing, with ground-versatile Locked Down Lad also considered. ROMANY BROWN (IRE) BLUE IN THE WEST (IRE) LOCKED DOWN LAD
